claim: For the real Banach plane \(X_8=(\mathbb R^2,N)\) with \(N(s,t)=\max\{|s|,|t|,(|s|+|t|)/\sqrt2\}\), the Fu--Liu--Li centered-triangle constant satisfies \(Y_J(X_8)=2\sqrt2-1\). Equivalently, in the normalization of Ahmad--Fu--Li, \(\delta_{X_8}(1)=(3-2\sqrt2)/2\).
integrity: The proof uses an exact finite polyhedral reduction over Q(sqrt(2)) and an explicit attaining pair. No numerical experiment is used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact value for one real two-dimensional regular-octagonal norm; no classification of other norms. The accessible sources did not include the full text of the 2024 J_1 paper, leaving a stated residual literature risk.
title: Exact \(Y_J\) constant of the regular octagonal Banach plane
